# CANDIDATE: OPENING_RANGE_VWAP_PULLBACK_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Price often pulls back to VWAP after establishing an opening‑range bias, offering a high‑probability long entry. The opening range high break sets directional bias, and the subsequent VWAP pullback with bullish close and volume filter provides a low-risk entry point aligned with the intraday trend.

## Mechanism

Entry rule: If price breaks above the opening range high (ORH) within the first 30 minutes of RTH, then wait for a pullback candle that closes below the intraday VWAP with a bullish close (close > open) and volume > 1.5 × the average volume of the first 15 minutes; enter long at the close of that candle. Exit shape: chart-stop at opening range low (ORL), TP1 at 1.5R, runner trail 15% off high-water-mark. Regime hint: VIX < 20, time 09:45‑11:30, price above 20‑period EMA ribbon (uptrend).
